preconditions.description: The number of crimes n is between 0 and 10^18 inclusive.
The number of conditions c is between 0 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= mi for ti, mi in conditions)
preconditions.description: Each multiplicity mi in the conditions is a positive integer.

preconditions.expression: all(ti in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for ti, mi in conditions)
preconditions.description: Each crime type ti in the conditions is a capital Latin letter.
The number of conditions provided is between 0 and c inclusive.

postconditions.description: The number of ways to commit exactly n crimes without punishment is a non-negative integer less than 12345.
The return value is the count of valid sequences of length n that satisfy all the given conditions.
